inputs.text: Cubans deserve a future built on freedom, secure property, and the ability to provide for their families—not continued state control that leaves ordinary people without a real stake in their own lives. Any transition must restore personal responsibility and lawful ownership while keeping the nation’s destiny in Cuban hands. Freedom should not mean handing the country to outside investors or letting wealth dictate its future; sovereignty and the rights of families belong together.
